description: This file contains unit tests for the DittoMessageMapper class, verifying its ability to correctly map from ExternalMessage representations to internal Adaptable objects and vice versa, including handling error cases.

classes.name: DittoMessageMapperTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the DittoMessageMapper class, testing the mapping logic between ExternalMessage and Adaptable objects, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DittoMessageMapper instance before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleanup after each test; currently does nothing.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Tests successful mapping of valid incoming ExternalMessages to Adaptable objects.

methods.name: mapMessageFails
methods.description: Tests that invalid incoming ExternalMessages throw expected exceptions during mapping.

methods.name: mapAdaptable
methods.description: Tests successful mapping of Adaptable objects to ExternalMessages.

methods.name: mapAdaptableFails
methods.description: Verifies that invalid outgoing Adaptables throw exceptions during mapping.

methods.name: createValidIncomingMappings
methods.description: Creates a map of valid ExternalMessage to list of Adaptable objects for testing.

methods.name: valid1
methods.description: Constructs a sample valid ExternalMessage and expected Adaptable for the first test scenario.

methods.name: valid2
methods.description: Constructs a second sample valid ExternalMessage and expected Adaptable.

methods.name: createInvalidIncomingMappings
methods.description: Creates a map of ExternalMessages that should fail mapping, along with the expected exceptions.

methods.name: createValidOutgoingMappings
methods.description: Creates a map of Adaptable objects with corresponding ExternalMessages for testing successful outgoing mapping.

methods.name: createInvalidOutgoingMappings
methods.description: Returns an empty map, indicating no invalid outgoing mappings are tested.
